description: Is this healthcare provider precluded from the Pennsylvania Medical Assistance (Medicaid) program? Screens a person or business name, an NPI, a license number, and/or a federal EIN against the Pennsylvania Department of Human Services (DHS) Medicheck Precluded Providers List — the state-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (see the leie pack) for Pennsylvania specifically, and the sibling of ny_omig_check_exclusion (New York), ca_medical_check_exclusion (California), tx_medical_check_exclusion (Texas) and fl_medical_check_exclusion (Florida). Answers "is this provider precluded from Pennsylvania Medicaid", "check this NPI against the PA Medicheck list", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for a Pennsylvania Medicaid provider. An NPI, license-number, or FEIN match is an IDENTIFICATION (all three are exact, provider- or business-specific identifiers); a name match — even an exact one — is a CANDIDATE lead only, since this list carries no date of birth to tell same-named providers apart. Every match carries DHS's own Status field (Precluded, Terminated, Reinstated, Suspended, Withdrawal, and similar) and a currently_precluded flag DERIVED from that status — null with status_unknown:true on the minority of rows where DHS's own Status is blank, rather than a guess. This dataset covers everyone EVER precluded, not only those currently precluded. Pass npi, license, or fein to turn a name lead into an identification. Sourced from the Pennsylvania DHS Medicheck Precluded Providers List, keyless.

fein.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the business, if known. An EIN match is an identification.

license.description: Pennsylvania professional license number, if known, e.g. "AJ006399L". A license match is an identification.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "John Smith" or "Acme Home Health Inc". Matched against the provider's individual name, business name, and any recorded alias, any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification rather than a name lead — always pass it when known.

name: pa_medical_check_exclusion
title: Pa Medical Check Exclusion
